input.text:
**项目初始问题**

Self-Consistency（SC）是目前最主流的 LLM 推理聚合策略——采样多条 chain-of-thought，多数投票选答案。但 SC 有一个已知瓶颈：**准确率随采样数增加很快饱和**，加到 K=12 以上基本不再提升。

理论上，Condorcet Jury Theorem 说只要投票者独立且正确率 >50%，多数投票就会随人数增加趋近 100%。SC 达不到这个理论上限，说明某个前提被违反了。

**我们的假设是**：问题出在 traces 不独立（同一个模型采样出来的推理路径高度相关）。如果我们从 traces 中提取一阶逻辑（FOL）约束，用 MAX-SAT 求解器做结构化聚合（而非简单投票），也许能利用到 traces 之间的互补信息，突破 SC 的天花板。

这就是 SICA（Symbolic Invariant Consensus Aggregation）的出发点。

**结果**：假设的前半部分被完全验证——同模型 traces 确实高度相关（Fleiss' κ=0.21-0.82，12 条 traces 实际等效只有 1.3-3.6 个独立投票）。但后半部分全面失败——自提取的符号约束继承了模型自身的偏差，无法提供独立信息。12 种修复尝试 + 3 种方法级干预全部无效。

论文最终转为 negative result paper：**independence bottleneck 是同模型推理聚合的结构性限制**，跨三个模型家族普遍存在，且目前没有纯同模型方案能突破。

input.text:
**12 种修复尝试（prompt-level，在原始 SICA pipeline 内调整）**

核心思路：不改变"从 traces 提取约束 → MAX-SAT 聚合"的框架，尝试在各环节优化。

| # | 修复 | 思路 | 结果 |
|---|------|------|------|
| 1 | Contrastive prompting | 换 prompt 策略让模型生成更多样的 traces | 约束非判别性从 8.2% 降到 6.0%，但 Δ 不变 |
| 2 | Cross-model extraction | 用不同模型（Qwen3-14B/Qwen2.5-14B）提取约束，解 traces 同源问题 | L1 ≈ L0 << L3，换提取器无效 |
| 3 | Generational scaling | 增加 K 到更大值 | Eff-K 饱和，边际收益趋零 |
| 4 | Solver-guided refinement | 让 MAX-SAT 结果反馈回模型做迭代优化 | 无显著改善 |
| 5 | Consistency filtering | 过滤掉与多数约束矛盾的约束 | ~92% 约束本身就是 discriminative，过滤是 near-no-op |
| 6 | Cross-trace UNSAT | 用跨 trace 的不一致性作为信号 | 不一致性太少（contradiction rate 2-6%） |
| 7 | Discriminative filtering | 移除非判别性约束（对所有候选答案给出相同分数的约束） | 0 gains，问题不在约束缺乏判别力 |
| 8 | T=1.0 高温采样 | 提高温度增加 trace 多样性 | κ 从 0.46 降到 0.39（更独立了），但 Δ 从 +3.43pp 崩到 0.00pp |
| 9 | Multi-temperature 混合 | 混合 T=0.3/0.7/1.2 各 4 traces | κ=0.43, Eff-K=2.11（更独立），Δ=0.00pp。SC baseline 反而提升了 +3.4pp |

（注：部分修复在不同 seed/数据集上重复测试，总共覆盖 9 种独立策略方向）

---

**3 种方法级干预（method-level，改变约束生成架构）**

核心思路：SICA 的约束从 traces 中提取，天然继承 trace 偏差。能否绕过这个循环依赖？

| 方法 | 思路 | 靶向的瓶颈 | 结果 |
|------|------|-----------|------|
| **ICG**（Independent Constraint Generation） | 不从 traces 提取约束，让模型直接从题目生成 FOL 约束（不解题） | 打破 trace→constraint 循环依赖 | Δ≈0（噪声级）。约束质量客观更好（99.4% Z3 编译，冗余率更低），但 κ=0.47≈SC 的 0.44 → 模型偏差从问题理解阶段就存在 |
| **Contrastive Scoring** | 为每个候选答案分别生成 pro（支持）和 con（反对）约束，差分评分 | 打破 confirmation bias | Δ=-9.3pp (FOLIO), -4.5pp (LogiQA)。62.7% 约束 trivially satisfied，pro 系统性多于 con，bias 从提取转移到了生成 |
| **Debate** | 同模型扮演 Proposer/Critic 辩论，从辩论记录提取约束 | 打破 trace 同质性，引入对立视角 | Δ=-18.6pp (FOLIO), -23.0pp (LogiQA)。κ 成功从 0.44 降到 0.15（确实更独立了），但 accuracy 崩溃 → 7B 模型角色扮演严重退化推理质量 |

**总结**：12+3=15 种干预覆盖了 diversity / architecture / independence / verification / filtering 全维度，全部失败。Debate 是唯一成功打破 trace 相关性的方法（κ 从 0.44→0.15），但代价是 accuracy 灾难性下降——这揭示了 **independence-accuracy trade-off**：同模型框架下，traces 要么一致（高 κ、正确但不独立），要么分歧（低 κ、独立但不正确）。

# Literature Map — symb_invariant_consensus (SICA)
# Last updated: 2026-05-16
# Purpose: Track related work coverage for EMNLP 2026 submission

dimensions:

  self_consistency_and_variants:
    description: "Self-Consistency (SC) decoding and improvements"
    papers:
      - id: wang2023sc
        title: "Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models"
        authors: "Wang et al."
        venue: "ICLR 2023"
        arxiv: "2203.11171"
        relevance: "Foundational SC method; our primary baseline"
        status: must_cite

      - id: chen2024usc
        title: "Universal Self-Consistency for Large Language Model Generation"
        authors: "Chen et al."
        venue: "ICML 2024"
        arxiv: "2311.17311"
        relevance: "Extends SC to free-form answers via LLM-based selection; alternative aggregation"
        status: must_cite

      - id: taubenfeld2025cisc
        title: "Confidence Improves Self-Consistency in LLMs"
        authors: "Taubenfeld et al."
        venue: "ACL Findings 2025"
        arxiv: "2502.06233"
        relevance: "Weighted voting via model confidence; reduces samples 40-50%. Shows SC can be improved with non-uniform weighting — SICA uses constraint-based weighting instead"
        status: must_cite

      - id: kim2026reasc
        title: "Reliability-Aware Adaptive Self-Consistency (ReASC)"
        authors: "Kim et al."
        venue: "2026"
        relevance: "Response-level confidence for early halting; 70-80% cost saving vs naive SC"
        status: should_cite

      - id: loo2025reevaluating
        title: "Reevaluating Self-Consistency Scaling in Multi-Agent Systems"
        authors: "Loo et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"
        arxiv: "2511.00751"
        relevance: "CRITICAL — shows SC gains plateau early and can decline at high sample counts for strong models. Directly supports our QwQ-32B finding (SICA≡SC when model is too consistent)"
        status: must_cite

      - id: wan2024rasc
        title: "Reasoning-Aware Self-Consistency (RASC)"
        authors: "Wan et al."
        venue: "2024"
        relevance: "Combines answer-level and rationale-level features; reduces samples ~88%"
        status: should_cite

      - id: li2023diverse
        title: "Making Language Models Better Reasoners with Step-Aware Verifier"
        authors: "Li et al."
        venue: "ACL 2023"
        arxiv: "2206.02336"
        relevance: "DiVeRSe: diverse prompts + step-aware verification for SC improvement. Combines diversity generation with trained verifier — shows diversity alone insufficient without verification quality."
        status: must_cite
        verified: true

      - id: dsc2025
        title: "Difficulty-Adaptive Self-Consistency"
        authors: "Various"
        venue: "NAACL Findings 2025"
        relevance: "Ranks problem difficulty to allocate sampling budget; complementary efficiency approach"
        status: optional

  symbolic_reasoning_llm:
    description: "Neuro-symbolic methods combining LLMs with formal solvers"
    papers:
      - id: olausson2023linc
        title: "LINC: A Neurosymbolic Approach for Logical Reasoning by Combining Language Models with First-Order Logic Provers"
        authors: "Olausson et al."
        venue: "EMNLP 2023"
        arxiv: "2310.15164"
        relevance: "LLM translates NL to FOL, external prover verifies; same-model translation pipeline like Logic-LM. Documents translation error rates (~40% on FOLIO). Key reference for self-extraction quality issues."
        status: must_cite
        verified: true

      - id: pan2023logiclm
        title: "Logic-LM: Empowering Large Language Models with Symbolic Solvers for Faithful Logical Reasoning"
        authors: "Pan et al."
        venue: "EMNLP Findings 2023"
        arxiv: "2305.12295"
        relevance: "LLM→FOL→solver pipeline; closest architectural ancestor to SICA. Key difference: Logic-LM uses single-path translation, SICA aggregates across multiple paths"
        status: must_cite

      - id: xu2026dylos
        title: "Adaptive LLM-Symbolic Reasoning via Dynamic Logical Solver Composition (DyLoS)"
        authors: "Xu et al."
        venue: "EACL 2026"
        arxiv: "2510.06774"
        relevance: "Multi-paradigm solver selection (LP/FOL/CSP/SMT); evaluated on FOLIO+ProofWriter. Outperforms Logic-LM. Key difference: DyLoS selects solver type, SICA aggregates constraints across paths"
        status: must_cite

      - id: fover2025
        title: "FoVer: First-Order Logic Verification for Natural Language Reasoning"
        authors: "Various"
        venue: "TACL 2025"
        relevance: "FOL verification for NL reasoning; strong results on ProofWriter+FOLIO. Uses verification rather than aggregation"
        status: must_cite

      - id: li2025survey
        title: "A Survey on LLM Symbolic Reasoning"
        authors: "Li et al."
        venue: "2025 (under review)"
        relevance: "Comprehensive survey; positions SICA within the broader landscape"
        status: should_cite

      - id: constraintllm2025
        title: "ConstraintLLM: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Industrial Constraint Programming"
        authors: "Various"
        venue: "EMNLP 2025"
        relevance: "Multi-instruction SFT for constraint extraction; different domain (industrial) but related extraction methodology"
        status: optional

        authors: "Loo et al."
        venue: "arXiv 2025"

        relevance: "CRITICAL — strong models produce near-identical paths, SC gains plateau/decline. Direct support for SICA≡SC on QwQ-32B"

        title: "Diversity-Aware Training for Test-Time Scaling"

        relevance: "Independent reasoning attempts collapse into similar solutions; diversity training needed to unlock test-time scaling. Supports our claim that non-reasoning models have more useful diversity"
